description_en: Queries the peak bandwidth and peak packet rates of attack traffic on one or more Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instances within a specific period of time
description_zh: 查询指定时间段内DDoS实例的攻击带宽峰值和攻击包速峰值
name: DescribeTotalAttackMaxFlow

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs in Resource Management. If you do not configure this parameter, the instance belongs to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh: DDoS高防实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。 不设置该参数表示默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

This UNIX timestamp must indicate a point in time that is accurate to the minute
parameters.help_zh:
查询结束时间。时间戳格式，单位：秒。
必须为整点分钟
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

This UNIX timestamp must indicate a point in time that is accurate to the minute
parameters.help_zh:
查询开始时间。时间戳格式，单位：秒。
必须为整点分钟
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the Anti-DDoS Proxy instances. Separate multiple instance IDs with commas (,). Example: InstanceIds.1, InstanceIds.2, InstanceIds.3
parameters.help_zh: 要绑定的DDoS高防实例ID。多个实例ID间以逗号分隔，例如：InstanceIds.1, InstanceIds.2, InstanceIds.3
parameters.name: instance_ids
